{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A refined knit top in a soft oat shade (#e3c3a2), tailored with a straight cut and a moderate length that rests just above the hips, crafted from fine merino wool for warmth without bulk.
Dark grey trousers in a fluid yet structured drape, featuring a tapered leg and an ankle-grazing hemline made of heavy cotton-wool blend to resist snow and road salt.
Black leather ankle boots with a low block heel, offering sturdy traction on icy sidewalks and a sleek silhouette that elongates the lower body.
This ensemble works perfectly for a frosty morning at work because the wool knit provides essential insulation against the cold while maintaining a polished professional look. The dark grey trousers add depth and seriousness to the outfit, contrasting beautifully with the skin-toned top and grounding the overall color palette. Finally, the black boots ensure practicality on salted roads without sacrificing elegance, making this an ideal choice for active movement in harsh winter conditions."}
